# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Games

## I. PLACEMENT GAMES
### A. Single Element Placement
- **Akari** - Place light bulbs in white squares
- **Kurotto** - Place black cells based on number constraints
- **Kurodoko** - Color cells black based on distance constraints

### B. Number Placement
- **Sudoku** - Place numbers 1-9 in grid
- **Nansuke** - Fill blank cells with numbers from a list
- **Makaro** - Fill cells with numbers based on room constraints and arrows
- **Ripple Effect** - Fill cells with consecutive numbers by room

### C. Shape/Block Placement
- **Shikaku** - Divide grid into rectangles containing one number
- **Chained Block** - Fill cells with black blocks in specific patterns
- **Choco Banana** - Paint cells black to form rectangles
- **LITS** - Place tetromino shapes in outlined areas
- **Shakashaka** - Place triangles in squares

### D. Block/Region Division
- **Fillomino** - Divide board into blocks matching numbers
- **Five Cells** - Divide grid into blocks of exactly five cells
- **Sashigane** - Divide grid into L-shaped blocks
- **Double Choco** - Divide grid into blocks with matching white/gray pairs
- **Norinori** - Place blocks containing exactly two black squares per region

## II. LINE-DRAWING GAMES
### A. Single Loop/Path
- **Slitherlink** - Connect dots to form single loop
- **Masyu** - Create loop through circles with constraints
- **Dotchi-Loop** - Draw loop through white circles
- **Mid-loop** - Draw loop with black circles as midpoints
- **Moon-or-Sun** - Draw loop through rooms selecting moons or suns
- **Nagareru** - Draw loop following wind/arrow directions
- **Suraromu** - Draw loop passing through numbered gates
- **Yajilin** - Draw loop avoiding numbered black cells
- **Numberlink** - Connect pairs of same numbers with lines

### B. Path/Line Drawing
- **Pencils** - Draw lines from pencil tips using numbered lengths

## III. COLORING/SHADING GAMES
### A. Black/White Cell Coloring
- **Hitori** - Color cells to eliminate duplicate numbers
- **Nurikabe** - Color cells black to form continuous wall with white regions
- **Nurimeizu** - Paint cells to create maze from S to G
- **Nurimisaki** - Fill cells with black/white following promontory rules
- **Tilepaint** - Color tiles following diagonal number constraints
- **Usowan** - Color cells following number constraints with one wrong number per region
- **Sto-stone** - Color cells as "stones" that drop to bottom half

### C. Shaded Region Coloring
- **Heyawake** - Paint cells in rooms with connection constraints
- **Nuritwin** - Shade cells creating two equal blocks per region
- **Norinori** - (see Block Placement)

### D. Triangle Placement (Coloring variant)
- **Shakashaka** - (see Shape Placement)

## IV. NUMBER/LOGIC CONSTRAINT GAMES
### A. Constraint-Based Number Placement
- **Makaro** - Fill numbers with arrow directional constraints
- **Ripple Effect** - Place consecutive numbers by room
- **Nansuke** - Fill numbers from provided list

### B. Fill-in with Regional Rules
- **Juosan** - Fill cells with dashes/pipes following territory constraints
- **Hebi** - Place snake numbers 1-5 sequentially with territorial constraints
- **Evolomino** - Place squares on arrows with evolving block sizes

## V. MOVEMENT/TRANSFORMATION GAMES
- **Satogaeri** - Move circles to countries based on distance numbers
- **Yosenabe** - Move circles into gray areas totaling specified values

## VI. HYBRID/MULTI-MECHANIC GAMES
- **Choco Banana** - (Color cells; also fits Coloring category)
- **Evolomino** - (Places shapes and arrows; also fits Placement)

---

## Alternative Organization by Primary Mechanic:

**Placement-Focused:** Akari, Sudoku, Nansuke, Shikaku, Fillomino, Chained Block, LITS, Shakashaka, Five Cells, Sashigane, Kurotto, Kurodoko, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Norinori

**Line-Drawing-Focused:** Slitherlink, Masyu, Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop, Moon-or-Sun, Nagareru, Suraromu, Yajilin, Numberlink, Pencils

**Coloring-Focused:** Hitori, Nurikabe, Nurimeizu, Nurimisaki, Heyawake, Tilepaint, Usowan, Sto-stone, Nuritwin, Choco Banana

**Logic/Constraint-Focused:** Juosan, Hebi, Double Choco, Evolomino

**Movement-Focused:** Satogaeri, Yosenabe
